title: provtrail record v1
description: One hash-chained record in a provtrail ledger. A record is valid iff captured_at is a parseable RFC3339 UTC timestamp AND (source_url is a non-empty string OR content_hash is a non-empty sha256:<64 hex> string).

schema.description: Explicit schema identifier. Never infer the record format from its keys.

id.description: "ev_" followed by the first 16 hex characters of record_hash's digest.

captured_at.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp when the source was captured. Required.

content_hash.description: sha256 hash of the captured content, as sha256:<64 hex>.

tool.description: Which backend captured this record, e.g. web-search:api, browser:manual.

query.description: Search query, if this record came from a search.

claim.description: The claim this source is evidence for.

snippet.description: Short supporting excerpt from the source.

archived_url.description: URL of an archived copy of the source.

path.description: Artifact path, relative to the ledger's directory. Absolute paths and paths leaving the directory are invalid (checked by provtrail verify).

prev_hash.description: record_hash of the previous record in the ledger, or null for seq 1.

record_hash.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON of this record without the record_hash (and id) keys.
